{{Quote|Onca, you and your brother have been a legendary team. This challenge may prove difficult with you alone.|Dooku, to Onca, after Bulduga's death|<ref name="TB" />}}
'''Onca''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from the planet [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He primarily worked with his brother, [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]], in their legendary bounty hunting team. Onca and his brother traveled to [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to take part in a contest within [[Box/Legends|The Box]], though [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]] never took part in the competition because he was killed by bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. Onca also perished, but in the second challenge from an [[Electrified laser blade/Legends|electrified laser blade]].

==Biography==
Onca and his brother formed a legendary duo throughout their bounty hunting careers.<ref name="TB" /> Eventually, their many successes caught the attention of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who invited them to compete with several other bounty hunters in [[The Box]], a death machine that tested the skill and mind of each person who entered it's deadly grasp. The Box was designed by [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], a [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] mastermind who was behind the plot to capture [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The contest was held on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], Count Dooku's homeworld. The five contestants that survived The Box, would win the honor of kidnapping Chancellor Palpatine to use as leverage to free all captured [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leaders from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="TB" />

[[File:OncaBulduga-TB.png|thumb|left|200px|Onca, and his brother, Bulduga]]
Unfortunately, [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]] did not live to take part in the competition. Another participant, [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], fancied Bulduga's [[Hat/Legends|hat]] and asked how he got it. Bulduga, recognizing the tension of the conversation, responded by drawing out his pistol, but wasn't fast enough. Bane drew his blaster first, shot Buldaga and took his hat while Onca looked on. Onca was not a fool and did not face off against Cad Bane, though he did secretly mourn for his brother.<ref name="TB" />

All contestant were required to give up their weapons before entering The Box. The contestants were herded onto an elevator and escorted by [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|magnaguards]] into a pristine white chamber that sported square paneling on all sides. As the contestants regarded their surroundings, a panel in the middle of the floor sank, creating a small shaft which released [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas into the room. Onca and the other bounty hunters retreated from the gas, heading toward the outer edges of the chamber. As the gas progressed it's way into the room, several panels began to slowly ascend from the floor, providing platforms for the competitors to perch on above the gas. Despite his sluggish maneuverability, Onca managed to obtain a foothold on one of the rising platforms. Though, as the platforms continued to rise, it became clear that the exit was not up but down. [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], secretly [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], scouted out the floor of the chamber and discovered that the shaft that released gas into the room had a secret tunnel at it's bottom. Onca was the last to drop down into the gas to follow Hardeen and survived the first challenge.<ref name="TB" />

[[File:OncaImpaled-TB.png|thumb|right|200px|Onca is impaled by an electrified laser blade in the second test.]]
The room they entered into from the tunnel was very dark and cubical in shape. A panel, tipped with an electrified laser blade, slid forward across the room and would have impaled Onca if he had not dodged it. Several more panels, also tipped with the same deadly weapon as the first, slid across the room. Onca became suddenly boxed in by several panels and was forced to stand perfectly still as a panel slid towards him. The blade stopped inches short from slicing into Onca's head, much to Onca's relief. Though Onca was caught off guard and impaled through the back by an electrified laser blade that sprouted out of the panel behind him.<ref name="TB" />

The five contestants that escaped The Box in the end were [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], Cad Bane, Rako Hardeen and [[Embo/Legends|Embo]]. They went on to kidnap the Chancellor at the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TB" />

==Personality and traits==
Onca was a naturally slow and not very agile [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] with a steadfast and wise attitude. Although [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] killed his brother, Bulduga, for his hat, Onca did not seek vengeance because he knew that he was out matched and would die if he tried.<ref name="SWE" />

==Equipment==
Unlike Bulduga, Onca prioritized firepower over his brother's more stealthy and quick maneuvers, thus his weapons of choice were a pair of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blasters]], that included an [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifle]] and an [[Avarik Armaments long rifle]].<ref name="SWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Onca's first and only appearance was in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]], episode The Box.<ref name="SWE" />

Onca and Bulduga are not to be confused with [[Del Moomo|Del]] and [[Dob Moomo]] created by [[John Jackson Miller]].
